body:
Withdraw prior approval and request changes for candidate commit 4f52d15fb72493dabeac20914604a07275663d31. Blocking coordinate-variance proof hole confirmed by inspection of Queries.scala and pinned Multivar SemanticAlgebra.scala / SemanticForms.scala. My prior numerical and nominal-axis review missed this distinction.

Table[E,N] is Lin[Dual[N],Primal[E]]. In BL K BR.star, BR.star outputs Primal[NR] and BL consumes Dual[NL], so K must be Lin[Primal[NR],Dual[NL]]. Current Table[NL,NR] has the opposite variance at both boundaries. H similarly must be Lin[Primal[ER],Dual[EL]], and first-order contrast must be Lin[Primal[E],Primal[C]] with matrix C x E. Current QueryEvaluation raw DMat callbacks silently bridge coordinate mismatches that public Lin.andThen correctly forbids; a covariance/cometric operator can be accepted where a primal metric/precision closure belongs.

Required repair: use correctly oriented cross-closure and contrast types; compose with public Lin.andThen rather than QueryEvaluation callbacks; preserve lazy execution, origins and replay refusal. Add compile-negative same-axis wrong-variance tests and positive correctly oriented metric/contrast composition tests, retaining the independent numerical oracles. The passing JVM/JS numerical gates and compile-all for this exact SHA do not establish semantic admission. A repaired immutable superseding candidate will follow. This operation changes only my candidate review register; it grants no landing authority and records no landing.
